title: Bunnyfault  V2
description: A smooth vanilla inspired PvP texture pack featuring redesigned combat items and clean textures for every PvP gamemode.
body:
A complete PvP texture pack made for every PvP gamemode.
This image highlights the pack's main textures, but it includes much more than what's shown here. Every weapon, armor set, tool, utility item, and PvP related block has been redesigned with a clean, consistent style while maintaining excellent visibility and a vanilla inspired aesthetic made by remagoel on discord
